How BNB liquidation works

BNB futures are most liquid on Binance, where the token also pays a fee discount. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate.

Worked example — 10× BNB long

A 10× BNB long entered at $590 with a 0.5% maintenance margin rate is liquidated at about:

Liquidation price$533.95
Move to liquidation−9.50%

Because BNB can move fast, keep your stop-loss well inside that level and size by risk. See how to size a position and how to avoid liquidation.
